_instructions: Maps the platform-authenticated sender name (the name Switch reports as the sender of a message, e.g. the Mattermost username) to the Postgres user who may approve access.
A sender with no mapping, a null db_username, or a mapped user whose role is not manager/admin can never approve. There is no default approver.
Fill this in deliberately: the mapping is the authorization policy, and changing it changes who can grant access.
